units: ROIC and WACC as decimal fractions; spread = ROIC minus WACC

historical_window.method: Unweighted arithmetic mean of the 12 published annual industry ratios and the same 12 WACC snapshots. Each annual ROIC is already based on aggregate sector earnings/capital; the mean is not a pooled 12-year earnings/capital ratio, company-weighted mean, time-series investment return, or risk-free benchmark.
historical_window.limitation: Industry membership and data providers can change across snapshots. This is an average of published sector snapshots under the same explicit return column, not a fixed-company panel. Each vintage generally uses available TTM accounting data from the preceding year.

timing: January 2026 dataset, primarily latest available trailing 12-month accounting data through Q3 2025, with prior year-end market values. This is not full-year 2026 profitability.
roic_definition: Aggregated operating profits adjusted for leases treated as debt and R&D as capital expense, after effective taxes, divided by aggregate book invested capital.
wacc_definition: Cost of equity × E/(D+E) + pre-tax cost of debt × (1-marginal tax rate) × D/(D+E), using aggregate market equity and debt including leases.
aggregation: Ratio of aggregate sector operating earnings to aggregate sector invested capital, not the simple average of company ROICs.
source_caveat: Utility (Water) uses the dedicated ROC workbook; the EVA workbook contains a mismatching ROC for that row. The ROC HTML footer has a stale 2025 date; the analysis header and workbooks are dated January 2026.

companies.coverage: 32 named US companies, two per NYU industry across 16 industries. Companies and classification verified in NYU January 2026 lookup. This is a finite teaching comparison, not an exhaustive industry or global ranking.
companies.ranking_rule: Highest GuruFocus TTM ROIC among the two disclosed candidates, subject to positive prior-annual and latest-quarter average invested capital. Negative ROIC is valid when invested capital is positive.

methodology.company_source: GuruFocus public ROIC definition pages, same-company WACC and TTM ROIC from each dated paragraph.
methodology.company_wacc: GuruFocus uses market equity, book debt, CAPM cost of equity with a 6% market premium, and after-tax cost of debt. Assumptions differ from NYU industry estimates.
methodology.company_roic: After-tax operating income divided by average invested capital. The page calculation defines invested capital as total assets minus accounts payable and accrued expenses minus excess cash.
methodology.capital_check_scope: Both the prior-annual and latest-quarter average invested capital shown in the public calculation section were positive. These checks do not independently reconstruct the provider TTM denominator.
methodology.do_not_use_page_title: The headline ROIC is annualized latest-quarter ROIC. Use ttm_roic_pct from the explicitly labelled TTM paragraph for this screen.
methodology.comparability: GuruFocus company ROIC and WACC use provider definitions and estimation assumptions. They are separate from Damodaran industry aggregates, whose ROIC capitalizes leases and R&D. Never rank or subtract the company and NYU industry metrics as if they were identical constructions.
methodology.dates: All final company ROIC/WACC paragraphs say 2026-10-18. Reporting quarters differ by fiscal calendar. These are not FY2026 forecasts.
methodology.missing: Null means unavailable or ineligible. No invented zeros. No financial industries screened.

nyu_company_data_unavailability.finding: NYU says company-specific metric downloads were discontinued after 2018 due to data-provider restrictions. The public 2026 workbook provides company identity, industry, geography and SIC, not ROIC or WACC.
nyu_company_data_unavailability.date_caveat: January industry data usually use latest trailing financials through Q3 of the prior year.
